en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Basic information about typological requierements, demands on the optimum structural system and creative construction design. Acquisition of basic knowledge and experience in conceptual work during design of production buildings, acquiring necessary typological principles, standards, ordinances and regulations.
